summary: Bandwidth Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the repurchase of approximately $20.8 million aggregate principal amount of its 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 in open-market transactions at a discount to par, paying cash. This leaves about $6.7 million outstanding from an initial $250 million issuance. The company has capped call transactions in place expected to remain effective despite the repurchases. The repurchases reduce debt and potential dilution. What to watch: the impact on diluted share count and any further opportunistic repurchases given the small remaining balance.
